Play your way on alc.ca with our PlayWise tools

A deposit limit helps you plan how much money you want to add to your alc.ca account each week, ensuring you stay within your budget and gamble responsibly. Promo Cash and “Scan to deposit” are not included.
How long do you want to play? Setting a session limit lets you decide how much time you want to play on alc.ca in a day.

A Daily Wager Limit allows you to control how much you spend on alc.ca every 24 hours to help keep gambling fun. This includes all the money you spend on games on alc.ca each day, whether you deposit that money or have won it. When setting a Daily Wager Limit, choose an amount covering all your daily purchases, including subscriptions.
A Break in Play can provide you the time you need to assess your gambling. Explore the options and decide if a break is right for you.
You can choose the break from gambling on alc.ca that works best for you between 1 and 90 days.
• You will be unable to sign in. A break cannot be reversed by you or by Atlantic Lottery.
• Any lottery and Proline wagers you have made will play out and any prizes will be added to your account. Future subscriptions will be cancelled.
• Marketing communications (email) will stop. You will need to turn off your App notifications.
• Promo cash, AL Rewards points or entries for promotional contests from alc.ca will remain in your account until you return to play unless the item had a specific expiry date.
You can take time away from gambling on alc.ca for 6, 12, 24 or 36 months.
• You will be unable to sign in. A break cannot be reversed by you or by Atlantic Lottery.
• Any lottery and Proline wagers you have made will play out and any prizes will be added to your account. Future subscriptions will be cancelled.
• Marketing communications (email) will stop. You will need to turn off your App notifications.
• Upon your return, if you choose to resume marketing, you will need to manually re-enable these communications.
• Promo cash, AL Rewards points or entries for promotional contests from alc.ca will remain in your account until you return to play unless the item had a specific expiry date.
The Take a Break button is available on all wager screens and the My Account dropdown on alc.ca.
Features to support Healthy Play when you come to a venue or casino

Stop by the PlayWise Information Centre located at both casino locations to access gambling-related information and educational tools, links to community resources, or to speak with one of our PlayWise Advisors. PlayWise Advisors are onsite to provide information, education and support to players, employees, and guests.
To access tools at Red Shores, visit or call the PlayWise Information Centre at Red Shores at 902.620.4267.
A key message we always share with our players is that gambling is not a way to make money, but an experience to enjoy. If you do win, consider it a bonus to your experience.
If you or someone you know has questions or concerns about their play, free and confidential support is just a phone call away.
Nova Scotia 1-888-429-8167 (Mental Health and Addictions Crisis Line)
